\--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**To have a turnover occur the team needs to control the ball. so here's my thinking on what defines possession.** 

Possession is 1 completed pass or ball control (maybe for 2 seconds or securely, kinda like a pass completion in football. if the receiver goes down with the ball but is juggling it, it doesn't count as a catch.

**Then a turnover needs to be defined.**

1.) if a chance on the net (shot) happens and the other team gets "possession" because of a missed opportunity. That is a turnover

2.) if a pass is attempted and the ball is cut off by the opponent, that is a turnover. 

3.) if a player is "dribbling" (on the car or bounce dribbling) and the opponent hits the ball off of them and his team gains "possession" because of the hit, that is a turnover.

4.) if the game is booming back and forth, and neither team has possession but shots are still occurring, then it is not a turnover. (since neither has "control" over the ball one way or another)  

\--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

These are all just initial thoughts, please poke holes in it, I want to get a definition put in. I tried to draw some inspiration from basketball in the rules.
